LanguageData.IcecreamTailFood.label: tail ice cream
LanguageData.IcecreamTailFood.description: A peculiar ice cream with an unusual texture. If a hungry Nivarian eats it, their tail will turn into this very same ice cream!
LanguageData.IcecreamTailRestoreIce.label: Ice!
LanguageData.IcecreamTailRestoreIce.description: Slow-melting ice made from shed Nivarian scales. Perfect for adding to ice cream. An ice dragon who eats it can instantly restore their ice cream tail.
